effectiveness.design: Multicenter Australian field study (JX9604.03-C009), 9 clinics, October 2003 to August 2004; 4 treatment groups (no preanesthetic + ALFAXAN maintenance n=17; preanesthetic + ALFAXAN maintenance n=47; preanesthetic + halothane n=28; preanesthetic + isoflurane n=90); ALFAXAN 10 mg/mL IV over ~60 s to effect up to 2.0 mg/kg, maintenance increments ~0.5-0.7 mg/kg

effectiveness.quote: Of the 79 dogs treated with CLAVAMOX Tablets, 68 or 86% were evaluated by the investigator as cured compared to 36 of 48 or 75% cured with AMOXI-TABS.
